prompt: Spring Boot Undertow access log %D response time prerequisite
answer:
To use Undertow’s `%D` response-time attribute in a Spring Boot access log, enable Undertow’s request-start-time recording:

```properties
server.undertow.options.server.record-request-start-time=true
server.undertow.accesslog.enabled=true
server.undertow.accesslog.pattern=%t %a "%r" %s (%D ms)
```

`%D` reports the request-processing time in milliseconds. Without `record-request-start-time=true`, `%D` (and `%T`) may appear as `-`.
